scientific_integrity: All finite identities checked by standard-library rational enumeration; infinite stationary distribution conclusions use a separate analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Fully discrete uniform independent equipartition, linear attractive forces, positive confinement and Gaussian additive forcing; Gaussianity at reflection does not imply exact continuous Gibbs sampling. Fourth defect may be infinite. Published precedence remains subject to specialist review.
title: Gaussianity resonance and a strict fourth-moment defect in random-batch harmonic sampling
